text:
Maddy: quick async question — I'm seeing a p95 TTFT jump on model-prod around 11:10 UTC, looks correlated with token rate bursts. Anyone else seeing it?
Dan: seen that, noticed tokens/sec for that shard went from ~1200 -> 2200 for a few mins.
Sara: link to dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/TTFT/ttft-overview?panelId=3 — check the overlay for tokens/sec.
Maddy: thanks. which panel shows the token ingestion vs serving latency? need a direct panel for incident notes.
Priya: panel 7 (request_token_rate) + panel 3 (ttft_p95) side-by side in that dashboard. bookmark: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/TTFT/ttft-side-by-side?from=now-2h&to=now
Joey: adding PromQL we use for the token rate rollup:
```
sum(rate(inference_tokens_total{env="prod",model=~"gpt-.*"}[1m])) by (shard)
```
Maddy: nice. can we get a trace sample? jaeger link?
Sara: jaeger: https://jaeger.redwood.internal/search?service=inference-serving&operation=generate — filter by trace tag:ttft>400ms and tokens>500.
Maddy: thinking alert changes — current p99 TTFT alert fires frequently during bursty token periods. proposal: move p99 threshold from 900ms -> 1200ms for low-qps shards and add tokens/sec filter. Thoughts?
Dan: +1 to adding tokens/sec filter, otherwise noise. we should target: p99 TTFT > 1200ms AND tokens/sec per-shard > 1500 for 5m.
Priya: can you draft the alert rule? i can review. prefer using recording rules to avoid expensive queries.
Joey: started a small PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/482 — changes alert expression and adds runbook link. cc @Sara for runbook update.
Sara: I’ll update the runbook with the new thresholds and include quick hunt steps (dashboard links + jaeger filter).
Maddy: pinging for code review: @Dan can you look at the PR? it's tiny.
Dan: on it, will review in an hour.
deploy-bot: Observability PR #482 ready for review — CI passed. :rocket:
Maddy: Also, can we add a short grafana panel that shows p50/p95/p99 + tokens/sec stacked for the last 15m so on-call can triage faster?
Joey: good idea — I'll add a compact panel and attach to the incident landing dashboard, will link here when done.
Sara: FYI I'll create a short slack snippet for runbook: commands to run for quick triage + list of panels to check.
Maddy: thanks team. I'll follow up after Dan's review and we can ship the alert tweak.
Sara: tagging followups — add to next-week observability sync agenda so we can bake in token-aware alerts more broadly.
Maddy: done. :thumbsup:
